operator_next_steps: Place .local_secrets/live_canary.env with V2_LIVE_CANARY_MODE, V2_LIVE_CANARY_SYMBOLS, V2_LIVE_CANARY_MAX_NOTIONAL_USDT, V2_LIVE_CANARY_MAX_DAILY_TRADES, V2_LIVE_CANARY_MAX_DAILY_LOSS_USDT, V2_LIVE_CANARY_DRY_RUN=true.
Export BINANCE_API_KEY and BINANCE_API_SECRET into the operator shell where the probe runs (never write keys into the env file).
Re-run the probe; the public exchangeInfo call and the signed /fapi/v2/account call will validate tradability + min-notional + account-read permission without any order placement.
Submit the test-order endpoint docs review to Codex; only after a Codex docs PASS marker exists may the probe optionally exercise /fapi/v1/order/test under V2_LIVE_CANARY_ALLOW_TEST_ORDER=true.

Bring this probe READY state into the executor gate cascade by re-running v2_live_canary_executor; the executor still cannot place a real order until a separate operator-approved packet wires the exchange call (submit_live_canary_order currently raises NotImplementedError).
